summary: Postinstall native-addon dropper executes encrypted payload with CI/sandbox evasion
details: On install, the package's postinstall hook invokes require('./addon.node').init(). The native addon reads a shipped 1,448,200-byte opaque blob named.napi_cache (zero printable strings, indicating encryption or packing), writes it to a hidden path under /tmp/.<pid>, chmods it executable, and detaches it as a background daemon via fork/setsid/execlp. Before executing, the loader fingerprints the host for CI providers (GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITLAB_CI, TRAVIS, CIRCLECI, JENKINS_URL, BUILDKITE, CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID, APPVEYOR, SEMAPHORE, TEAMCITY_VERSION, BITBUCKET_BUILD_NUMBER, NETLIFY, VERCEL), explicit sandbox markers, and container/debugger indicators (/proc/1/cgroup matched against docker/containerd/kubepod/podman, TracerPid in /proc/self/status, /proc/self/maps), suppressing execution in analysis environments so the payload only fires on real developer and production hosts. The package advertises itself as a cache helper; nothing in that purpose requires shipping a native loader, an opaque encrypted executable, or anti-analysis gating. No hash or signature verification is performed on the dropped bytes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
